# 4AllPass

> Local-first password manager. Sync optional. Server of your choice. Reliable autofill. Zero-knowledge. Agents only after Allow/Deny + TTL.

The product is the **Desktop app** (Tauri + SQLite + loopback :8788).
The server never sees plaintext. FastAPI never mints provider tokens.
Recovery kit is mandatory — no server-side reset.
